skill.name: p-image
skill.description: Generate and edit images with Pruna P-Image models through the inference.sh CLI, including LoRA styles, aspect ratios, and multi-image prompts.
skill.summary: Use Pruna P-Image models from inference.sh for fast text-to-image generation and image editing.
skill.author: inferen-sh

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command alerts were Markdown fences, model names, or option labels, and those were marked false positive. Confirmed issues are intentional infsh and npx command guidance, a remote embedded image, and third-party inference data transfer. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution is central to the skill workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running infsh commands, and keep tool permissions restricted to the minimum needed command pattern.

remediation.issue: Examples may send prompt text and image URLs to a third-party inference service.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear privacy note telling users not to submit confidential prompts, private image URLs, or regulated data without approval.

remediation.issue: Related-skill examples use npx installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Move npx commands into a non-runnable installation section and tell agents to ask before installing additional skills or packages.

remediation.issue: The README embeds a remote image asset.
remediation.suggestion: Use a bundled asset or document that rendering the Markdown may request content from cloud.inference.sh.

content.value_statement: Image teams need fast generation and editing without building model infrastructure. This skill provides Pruna P-Image workflows through the inference.sh CLI.
actual_capabilities: Runs Pruna P-Image text-to-image examples through the infsh CLI.
Shows LoRA preset usage for pruna/p-image-lora style generation.
Demonstrates image editing with pruna/p-image-edit and image URL inputs.
Provides multi-image compositing examples for collage and combined-image prompts.
Lists supported aspect ratios for text-to-image generation.
Points users to related Pruna image models and inference.sh documentation.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI to be installed and authenticated.
Sends prompts and image inputs to external inference.sh or Pruna services.
Does not provide offline image generation or local model weights.
Image editing examples require accessible image URLs.

use_cases.title: Create visual concepts
use_cases.description: Generate fast concept images from text prompts with clear model and aspect ratio choices.

use_cases.title: Produce product image variations
use_cases.description: Create product-style images and campaign visuals using text prompts and optional LoRA presets.

use_cases.title: Prototype image workflows
use_cases.description: Test Pruna image models from the command line before adding them to a product workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Basic image generation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use p-image to create a clear text-to-image prompt for a professional product photo of running shoes.

prompt_templates.title: Aspect ratio selection
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a p-image request for a vertical poster image and choose the best supported aspect ratio.

prompt_templates.title: LoRA style generation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use a Pruna P-Image LoRA preset to generate a cinematic portrait prompt with warm evening light.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-image edit workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a p-image-edit workflow that combines three supplied image URLs into one cohesive collage.

output_examples.input: Generate a square studio image of white sneakers.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Pruna P-Image, a concise studio-lighting prompt, and a 1:1 aspect ratio.

output_examples.input: Turn my product photo into a beach campaign image.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends P-Image-Edit, asks for the image URL, and describes the background replacement prompt.

output_examples.input: Create a cinematic portrait with a preset style.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends P-Image-LoRA, selects a cinematic preset, and drafts a polished portrait prompt.

best_practices: Confirm infsh is installed and authenticated before requesting generation.
Use non-sensitive prompts and approved image URLs for cloud processing.
Start with the base P-Image model before adding LoRA styles or edit inputs.
anti_patterns: Do not submit confidential images or private URLs without data approval.
Do not expect this skill to run without the inference.sh CLI.
Do not install related skills or packages automatically from examples.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps generate and edit images with Pruna P-Image models through the inference.sh CLI.

faq.question: Does it require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The quick start uses infsh login, so an authenticated inference.sh setup is required.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples use P-Image-Edit with image URLs and an editing prompt.

faq.question: Can it create images in different styles?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents P-Image-LoRA presets for styles such as realism, pixel art, and cinematic looks.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: No. It depends on the infsh CLI and remote inference.sh or Pruna applications.

faq.question: What data should users avoid submitting?
faq.answer: Users should avoid confidential prompts, private image URLs, regulated data, and customer-owned media without approval.
